page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-8-lssd is an x86_64 instance type powered by AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. It provides 8 vCPUs across 4 dedicated physical cores with 2 threads per core, alongside 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB RAM-per-vCPU ratio. Cache architecture features 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 (f, vnni, bf16) as well as hardware cryptographic accelerations via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance is configured with 402 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and lacks hardware GPU accelerators.

Benchmark measurements indicate solid compute efficiency, showing top-quartile performance in single-core stress-ng tests (2861.78) and Geekbench text processing (2485.0). General computational results fall squarely in the middle 50%, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 7005.0, a PassMark CPU score of 13509.39, and multi-core stress-ng throughput reaching 11477.34. While small-block cached memory bandwidth maintains 565.66 GB/sec, uncached throughput displays notable bottlenecks, registering weak read bandwidth at 38.69 GB/sec and poor write throughput at 13.97 GB/sec. Data manipulation workloads achieve 10.75 million Redis SET operations per second and 11.06 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

With its 1:8 core-to-memory allocation and integrated 402 GB local NVMe disk, this instance offers balanced hardware cost efficiency for memory-heavy and disk-caching tasks without the overhead of separate remote disk provisions. However, uncached memory bandwidth constraints limit performance for memory-streaming calculations or large-scale model inference. Workloads aligned with this server profile include in-memory caching systems, transactional relational databases, data processing pipelines, and web backend applications requiring fast scratch disks.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-8-lssd features 8 vCPUs across 4 physical AMD EPYC 9B14 cores, 64.0 GB of RAM, and 402 GB of local NVMe SSD storage on an x86_64 architecture without GPU accelerators. Delivering an 8.0 GB per vCPU memory density, it incorporates AVX-512 instructions and dedicated hardware cryptography flags. Benchmark testing indicates strong single-core compute performance alongside mid-tier results in Geekbench multi-core (7005.0) and PassMark CPU metrics (13509.39). While cached memory performance remains stable, large-block uncached write throughput is comparatively limited at 13.97 GB/sec. Operational throughput reaches 10.75 million Redis SET operations per second and 11.06 GB/sec in web serving. Given its generous memory capacity and integrated NVMe drive, the instance fits in-memory caching, local database deployments, and mid-tier backend services.
